description_en: Queries the details of the HTTP request header modification configuration for a site
description_zh: 查询站点的修改HTTP请求头配置详情
name: GetHttpRequestHeaderModificationRule

parameters.help_en: The ID of the site. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the configuration. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2867483.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.name: config_id

ConfigType.description_en:
The configuration type. Valid values:
global: Global configuration.
rule: Rule configuration
ConfigType.description_zh:
配置类型，取值范围：
global：全局配置。
rule：规则配置

RequestHeaderModification.description_en: The request header modification settings. Add, delete, and modify operations are supported
RequestHeaderModification.description_zh: 修改请求头，支持添加、删除、修改三种操作方式

items.description_en: The details of the request header modification

Name.description_en: The name of the request header

Operation.description_en:
The operation type. Valid values:

add: Add.
del: Delete.
modify: Modify
Operation.description_zh:
操作方式。取值范围：

add：添加。
del：删除
modify：变更

Type.description_en:
The value type. Valid values:
static: Static pattern.
dynamic: Dynamic schema
Type.description_zh:
值类型。取值范围：
static：静态模式。
dynamic：动态模式

Value.description_en: The value of the request header

Rule.description_en:
The rule content, which uses a conditional expression to match user requests. You do not need to set this parameter when adding a global configuration. Two scenarios are supported:
Match all incoming requests: Set the value to true.
Match specific requests: Set the value to a custom expression, such as (http.host eq "video.example.com")
Rule.description_zh:
规则内容，使用条件表达式来匹配用户请求。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。存在两种使用场景：
匹配所有传入请求：值设置为true
匹配指定请求：值设置为自定义表达式，例如：(http.host eq \"video.example.com\")

RuleEnable.description_en:
The rule switch. You do not need to set this parameter when adding a global configuration. Valid values:
on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
RuleEnable.description_zh:
规则开关。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

RuleName.description_en: The name of the rule. You do not need to set this parameter when adding a global configuration
RuleName.description_zh: 规则名称。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数

Sequence.description_en: The execution sequence of the rule. A smaller value indicates a higher priority
Sequence.description_zh: 规则执行顺序。数值越小越优先执行

SiteVersion.description_en: The version number of the site configuration. For sites with configuration version management enabled, you can use this parameter to specify the site version for which the configuration takes effect. Default value: 0
SiteVersion.description_zh: 站点配置的版本号。开启了配置版本管理的站点，可以通过该参数指定配置生效的站点版本，默认为版本0
